summary: With SAML configured, enable HTTPS redirect for SSO by adding extra_settings REDIRECT_IS_HTTPS with value '"True"' to the AnsibleAutomationPlatform spec, then check it in the gateway pod's settings.py.
questions: How do I enable HTTPS redirect for SAML on the platform gateway?
SAML SSO redirects to http on OpenShift

answer_card.title: HTTPS redirect for SAML (OpenShift)
answer_card.answer_md:
Edit the AnsibleAutomationPlatform:
```yaml
spec:
  extra_settings:
    - setting: REDIRECT_IS_HTTPS
      value: '"True"'
```
After the pod redeploys:
`oc exec -it <gateway-pod> -- grep REDIRECT /etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/settings.py`
